sectionSubtitle: Tailored engineering, cost optimization, and independent technical oversight for e-commerce and growing companies.

services.title: Cloud Cost Optimization & Ultra-Fast Hosting
services.businessFocus: Stop overpaying for bloated cloud servers. I audit your current infrastructure, migrate heavy setups to lean VPS/cloud architectures, and move company static sites to zero-cost global hosting with 99.9% uptime.
deliverables: Zero-cost, ultra-fast global hosting for static company sites
Load balancing, caching, and server speed tuning

services.title: Production-Grade E-Commerce & Web Apps
services.businessFocus: Slow websites kill sales. I build and optimize scalable e-commerce stores and custom business applications engineered for fast checkout, smooth traffic handling, and strong SEO performance.
deliverables: Database & query tuning (up to 35% faster load times)

services.title: Vibe-Coded App Refactoring & Bug Fixing
services.businessFocus: Built a prototype with AI tools that is now breaking or insecure? I audit, debug, and refactor fragile AI/vibe-coded apps into clean, secure, and maintainable production software.
deliverables: Root-cause debugging for complex, recurring bugs
Security hardening and clean code restructuring
Performance optimization for real-world user traffic

services.title: Practical AI Integration & Private LLMs
services.businessFocus: Automate repetitive business workflows without leaking sensitive company data. I integrate Agentic AI tools and set up private, local LLM systems that cut external API costs.
deliverables: Business workflow automation (e.g., WhatsApp & support bots)
Private, on-premise local LLM setup for data security

services.title: Independent Technical Consulting & Supervision
services.businessFocus: Already hired an agency or developer? Like a civil site engineer, I work on your behalf—auditing architecture, monitoring progress, and verifying code quality so you get honest delivery with zero shortcuts.
deliverables: Architecture review & honest tech stack roadmap
Clear, jargon-free quality reports for business owners

services.title: Office IT, Network & Business Systems
services.businessFocus: Move away from messy manual workflows to a secure, structured company IT setup—covering office networks, centralized file access, business emails, and attendance/IoT integration.
deliverables: Centralized file servers, VPN, and Active Directory setup
Custom business email routing and firewall security
Hardware, IP phone, and attendance system integration
